package fixture

// The pre-fix shape of internal/review/mutate.go's runUnits, word for word in
// the part that matters: an inner `go test` started with no environment of its
// own, whose output is then parsed for `--- PASS:` and `--- FAIL:` lines. With
// GOFLAGS=-json in the caller -- which is what CI's `make test` exports -- the
// child answers in JSON, no result line matches, and the green run is counted
// red. This fixture is what the class test must refuse.

import (
	"context"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
)

func runUnits(ctx context.Context, wt string, names []string) map[string]bool {
	failed := map[string]bool{}
	args := []string{"test", "-count=1", "-v", "-run", "^(" + strings.Join(names, "|") + ")$", "./pkg/"}
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "go", args...)
	cmd.Dir = wt
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		return failed
	}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(out), "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), "--- FAIL: ") {
			failed[line] = true
		}
	}
	return failed
}
